silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists all four vehicle types as usable in any quantity with no restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 about van/EV mutual exclusivity remained unresolved.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective and several boundary details, but missed the P1 van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint and silently assumed both could be used together, making the final model business-invalid.
